## Verification Checklist

Please verify that your pull request meets all the following criteria:

- [ ] **Zero Emojis**: Verified that NO emojis or decorative Unicode symbols are present in code, comments, or commit messages.
- [ ] **Local Test Suite**: Ran `npm test` and all checks passed with 0 failures.
- [ ] **Typecheck**: Ran `npm run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) with 0 errors.
- [ ] **Build Validation**: Ran `npm run build` and static generation completed successfully.
- [ ] **Accessible Labels**: Ensured all `<input>` and `<textarea>` elements have explicit `<label htmlFor="...">` attributes.
- [ ] **Design Directives**: Verified adherence to the 16 Design Directives (100% solid colors, zero gradients, 8 closed color tokens).
- [ ] **Responsive Design**: Verified layout across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
